title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Environmental Pollution Criminal Cases

articles.content_en: Article 2: The conduct prescribed in Articles 339 and 408 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, causing losses of public or private property of 300,000 yuan or more, or having any of the circumstances provided for in subparagraphs (10) to (17) of Article 1 of this Interpretation, shall be deemed as "causing heavy losses to public or private property or seriously endangering human health" or "causing heavy losses to public or private property or causing serious consequences of personal injury or death."

Article 5: Where the conduct prescribed in Articles 338 and 339 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China has just met the standard for investigating criminal liability, but the actor has taken timely measures to prevent the expansion of losses, eliminate pollution, fully compensate for losses, actively restore the ecological environment, and is a first-time offender with genuine repentance, it may be deemed as minor circumstances, and the actor shall not be prosecuted or shall be exempted from criminal punishment; if it is truly necessary to impose a criminal punishment, a lenient punishment shall be given.

Article 6: Where a person without a hazardous waste operating permit engages in business activities such as collecting, storing, utilizing, or disposing of hazardous waste, thereby seriously polluting the environment, the person shall be convicted and punished according to the crime of environmental pollution; if the act also constitutes the crime of illegal business operation, the person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions providing for a heavier punishment.
Where the act prescribed in the preceding paragraph has no circumstance of discharging pollutants exceeding standards, illegally dumping pollutants, or otherwise illegally causing environmental pollution, it may be deemed as a minor circumstance of illegal business operation with negligible harm, and shall not be regarded as a crime; if it constitutes other crimes such as the crime of producing or selling counterfeit or substandard products, it shall be dealt with as the other crime.

Article 7: Where a person, knowing that another person has no hazardous waste operating permit, provides or entrusts to that person the collection, storage, utilization, or disposal of hazardous waste, thereby seriously polluting the environment, the person shall be treated as joint crime.

Article 8: Where a person, in violation of national regulations, discharges, dumps, or disposes of pollutants containing toxic, radioactive, infectious disease pathogens, or other substances, and the act simultaneously constitutes the crime of environmental pollution, the crime of illegally disposing of imported solid waste, the crime of casting hazardous substances, or other crimes, the person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions providing for a heavier punishment.

Article 9: Where an environmental impact assessment institution or its personnel intentionally provides false environmental impact assessment documents, if the circumstances are serious, or is seriously irresponsible so that the issued environmental impact assessment documents are materially false and cause serious consequences, the person shall, in accordance with Articles 229 and 231 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, be convicted and punished for the crime of providing false certification documents or the crime of issuing certification documents that are materially false.

Article 11: Where a unit commits a crime prescribed in this Interpretation, the directly responsible supervisor and other directly liable persons shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the standards for conviction and sentencing prescribed in this Interpretation, and a fine shall be imposed on the unit.

Article 12: The monitoring data collected by the competent department of environmental protection and its subordinate monitoring agencies in the process of administrative law enforcement may be used as evidence in criminal proceedings.
The data obtained by the public security organ, alone or jointly with the competent department of environmental protection, through extraction and testing of pollutant samples, may be used as evidence in criminal proceedings.

Article 13: For the waste listed in the National Hazardous Waste Inventory, the determination may be made on the basis of evidence such as the source and generation process of the substance involved, the defendant's confession, witness testimony, and the approved or filed environmental impact assessment documents, in conjunction with written opinions issued by the competent department of environmental protection, the public security organ, or other authorities.
For the quantity of hazardous waste, the determination may be made by comprehensively considering evidence such as the defendant's confession, the production process, material consumption, and energy consumption of the enterprise involved, and the approved or filed environmental impact assessment documents.

Article 14: Where it is difficult to determine the specialized issues of environmental pollution involved in a case, the determination shall be made on the basis of an expert evaluation opinion issued by a judicial appraisal institution, or a report issued by an institution designated by the competent department of environmental protection of the State Council or the public security department, in conjunction with other evidence.

Article 16: The act of extracting substances from hazardous waste as raw materials or fuel without a hazardous waste operating permit, for the purpose of profit, and having circumstances such as discharging pollutants exceeding standards, illegally dumping pollutants, or otherwise illegally causing environmental pollution, shall be deemed as "illegally disposing of hazardous waste."

Article 17: The term "within two years" as used in this Interpretation shall be calculated and determined based on the time interval between the effective date of the administrative penalty for the first illegal act and the date of committing the corresponding act again.
The term "key pollutant-discharging unit" as used in this Interpretation refers to key monitored enterprises and other units that are determined by the competent department of environmental protection of the people's government at or above the level of a city divided into districts, and that shall install and use automatic monitoring equipment for pollutant discharge according to law.
The term "illegal gains" as used in this Interpretation refers to all illegal income obtained and obtainable from the conduct prescribed in Articles 338 and 339 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China.
The term "losses of public or private property" as used in this Interpretation includes the actual value of direct damage or reduction of property caused by the conduct prescribed in Articles 338 and 339 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the expenses incurred for necessary and reasonable measures to prevent the expansion of pollution and eliminate pollution, and the emergency monitoring expenses for handling sudden environmental incidents.
The term "ecological environmental damage" as used in this Interpretation includes the costs for ecological environmental restoration, the loss of service functions during the restoration period, the losses caused by permanent damage to ecological environmental functions, and other necessary and reasonable expenses.
The term "without a hazardous waste operating permit" as used in this Interpretation refers to not having obtained a hazardous waste operating permit, or exceeding the business scope of a hazardous waste operating permit.

Article 18: This Interpretation shall come into force on January 1, 2017. After this Interpretation comes into force, the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Handling of Criminal Cases of Environmental Pollution (Fa Shi [2013] No. 15) shall be simultaneously abolished; where judicial interpretations issued previously are inconsistent with this Interpretation, this Interpretation shall prevail.
